title: CME launches single stock futures enabling investors to trade SpaceX, Micron and others 23 hours a day
summary_full: CME Group on Monday launched cash-settled single-stock futures on 55 U.S. equities, along with micro-sized contracts on 22 names.
summary_public: CME Group on Monday launched cash-settled single-stock futures on 55 U.S. equities, along with micro-sized contracts on 22 names.
